name: Dee Thai Infused Blunt | Guava Gelato
description: Mixing the creamy, dessert flavors that all Gelato fans love with a burst of tropical, fruit notes that give this strain a unique and indistinguishable aroma and flavor profile that leaves users with a heavy and sedating body high, coupled with a euphoric and uplifting head buzz that will allow users to drift into a comfortable relaxation that combats any stresses, aches, or pains that the day may bring.
